text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, El. Thank you very much♪ ...Does this 
mean that other plan has been called off?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Didn't Sei-chan suggest that to you? 
Saying, for my birthday, "Why not take off 
that mask and celebrate the whole day as 
the plain El?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, what ears! Well, um, that was... 
more embarrassing than anything, so to 
speak—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...No, quite the contrary! Precisely 
because it's my birthday, I came here in 
masked style, *yes*!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because Grass, what brings you the 
absolute most joy, thrill, and sheer 
ecstasy! Is a fierce battle—am I right?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then how could I, El the world's 
strongest, not celebrate while being the 
world's strongest?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufufu, oh, El. You've gotten quite 
good at playing dumb, haven't you~"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, but you see, desu. Even if El 
were to take off her mask—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The first words I want to say are the 
same! "Happy birthday, Grass"!
